name: Hyrule Bass
desc: A freshwater fish found in rivers and lakes across Hyrule.

name: Hearty Salmon
desc: A fish that restores hearts when cooked. Found in cold waters.

name: Fireproof Lizard
desc: A lizard resistant to flames. Useful for heatproof elixirs.

name: Rugged Rhino Beetle
desc: A sturdy beetle with a powerful horn. Boosts attack when cooked.

name: Blue Nightshade
desc: A flower that blooms only at night. Used for stealth elixirs.

name: Hot-Footed Frog
desc: A swift frog that grants a speed boost when cooked.

name: Electric Darner
desc: A dragonfly that crackles with electricity. Grants shock resistance.

name: Winterwing Butterfly
desc: A butterfly that flutters in cold regions. Resists heat when cooked.

name: Cold-Footed Wolf
desc: A predatory wolf native to snowy mountains.

name: Mountain Goat
desc: A sure-footed goat found on rocky cliffs.
